newsitem.title: USA: ECRI delays July inflation data on Friday one hour.
newsitem.headline: ECRI delays July inflation data on Friday one hour.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute's (ECRI) Future Inflation Guage (FIG) for July will be released on Friday at 1125 EDT/1525 GMT, an hour later than usual, ECRI said on Thursday.
ECRI said that the delay was due to the relatively early release of the government's employment report.
"Typically, these figures lag the NAPM report by a few days," ECRI said in a statement. "As a result, to fully update the monthly FIG we must wait for the NAPM figures that are due out at 1000 EDT."
The report will be released to clients at 1115 EDT.
